query:
UPDATE invoices
        SET target_date = $2,
            branch_id = $3,
            discount = $4::float8,
            discount_unit = $5,
            customer_id = $6,
            total_price = $7::float8,
            gift_card_redeemed = $8::float8,
            urgent_charge = $9::float8,
            collection_method = $10,
            taxable_amount = $11::float8,
            vat_amount = $12::float8
        WHERE id = $1
